async def act(page):
    # Click the Issues link to navigate to the issues dashboard
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Issues').click()
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now on the issues page, find issue links that contain 'feature' in the title
    # Assuming issues are listed with link roles for their titles
    # Use filter to get links with name containing 'feature' (case-insensitive)
    issue_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='feature')
    # Get the count to ensure there is at least one
    count = await issue_links.count()
    if count == 0:
        # If no issues with 'feature' found, return an indication
        return 'No issue with feature in title found'
    # Click the first issue link (assuming it's the latest if sorted by creation date)
    await issue_links.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Check if the issue is closed by looking for 'Closed' text on the page
    closed_element = page.get_by_text('Closed')
    if await closed_element.count() > 0:
        status = 'closed'
    else:
        status = 'open'
    # Return the status
    return status
